_comment: Scene for the task force composition editor and the ship class picker that opens with it. Keys are explained in tools/scenes/fleet.json and wiki/Game-Recipes.md.

windows.name: task_force_composition_editor_window
windows._note: Centred in its file, but the code opens it beside the task force card: at 520,292 in vanilla and 768,292 with the mod, which fits the card's right edge plus 28 as well as the button [GUL-021]. The redesign moves btn_composition_editor from 608,43 to 470,3: the check shows which rule holds. Its height is 140 plus 43 per row (161 before the redesign). The code moves Cancel and OK below the last row.

windows.name: task_force_composition_editor_sub_unit_selection_window
windows._note: The code puts it at sub_unit_selection_window_default_pos of the editor (610,1 since the redesign: 6 px right of the editor, 596 put it 8 px over it). The game has nine ship classes; vanilla shows seven and scrolls; 450 px show nine, the playset's 14 scroll.

manual: Adding and removing a class, the role picker of a row
Saving a template and opening the template list: not seen in a check
checklist: Editor: plain frame, title strip with the title at the left and Close, template plate (reset, clear, template dropdown, save, delete), class rows from y 92, Cancel and OK under the last row
Editor opens beside the task force card (x 768) although its button moved to the title strip
Class picker: 6 px right of the editor, same top, title strip, all nine classes without scrolling

states.name: templates
states._note: The template list opened. Not reachable by the harness: a new game has no saved template, and Save did nothing after one click, with and without a changed count. Drawn by the renderer only.
